idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; actor a is owned by thread a % cores; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. Actors are slots of a vector and there is no per-actor mailbox: a worker's inbound ring is shared by every actor it owns, so the 120-producer mailbox contention the frameworks pay for is engineered out here by static placement
actor a lives on thread a % cores, so with cores=2 roughly half the pings and half the pongs cross a core
cores=1 is one thread with every actor in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable, which with 120 actors in flight is rare
